method.estimate: Independent per-recipe estimate from ingredient rows using scripts/data/food-composition-core.json (per 100 g, USDA FoodData Central/SR Legacy; EU label values for branded-type products). Spoon and piece weights from the dictionary spoonGrams or the table.
method.implausible: kcal off by more than 25%/33% (ratio < 0.75 or > 1.33) and ≥ 30 kcal; or energy density > 900 kcal/100 g; or sodium off ≥ 300 mg and more than 2×; or added sugar off ≥ 5 g. Strained recipes (broths, nut/oat milks) are exempt.
method.proposedFields: Core fields only for recalculations (calories, protein, totalFat, saturatedFat, totalCarbs, fiber, totalSugars, addedSugar, sodium, potassium). Rescaled recipes scale every stored field.
method.confidence: high = stored values confirmed by the estimate, only the serving count changes; medium = recalculated from fully specified ingredients; low = brand/sub-recipe dependent, unquantified rows, frying fat not listed, or uncertain yield.

criteria.weight-loss: Energy density ≤ 150 kcal/100 g (Rolls, "low energy density"). Meal: ≤ 500 kcal, fibre ≥ 3 g, sat. fat ≤ 3 g. Other: ≤ 200 kcal, sat. fat ≤ 2 g. Added sugar ≤ 2.5 g and no sugar/syrup/honey/juice/oat-drink ingredient. Needs a serving weight.
criteria.blood-pressure-friendly: Servings of 100 g or more: sodium ≤ 140 mg per 100 g (FDA "low sodium" meal level) and ≤ 600 mg per serving. Smaller servings: ≤ 140 mg per serving and ≤ 140 mg per 50 g (FDA "low sodium" rule for small portions). Potassium ≥ sodium (mg). Sat. fat ≤ 4 g (meal) / ≤ 2 g (other). Added sugar ≤ 2.5 g (DASH limits sweets). Sodium judged conservatively: the higher of the stored value and the ingredient estimate with ordinary (salted) canned beans and broth, unless the row itself says low-sodium/no-salt/rinsed.
criteria.diabetes-friendly: Meal: carbohydrate ≤ 60 g, total sugars ≤ 20 g and ≤ 12.5 g/100 g, fibre ≥ 3 g. Other: carbohydrate ≤ 25 g, total sugars ≤ 10 g and ≤ 10 g/100 g, fibre ≥ 2 g. Always: oil-free (same rule as the oil-free label), fibre ≥ 10% of carbohydrate, sat. fat ≤ 3 g, added sugar ≤ 2.5 g, no sugar/syrup/honey/juice/oat-drink ingredient, starch base not refined (white flour, white-rice flour/noodles, glass noodles, regular lasagne sheets, degermed polenta, GF starch mixes, breadcrumbs).
criteria.heart-healthy: No added oil (ingredient or method) and no coconut milk/cream/oil. Sat. fat ≤ 3 g (meal) / ≤ 2 g (other). Sodium ≤ 600 mg (meal) / ≤ 360 mg (other), same conservative sodium as above. Fibre ≥ 3 g (meal) / ≥ 1.5 g (other). Added sugar ≤ 2.5 g. Cholesterol 0 mg (all three packs are plant-based).
criteria.gluten-free: No wheat, spelt, rye, barley, bulgur, gluten flour, bread/crumbs/crispbread, regular lasagne sheets, barley coffee, rye sourdough starter or wheat soy sauce. Oats only if the row says gluten-free. Miso and bouillon pass with "use a GF-labelled product". Also must not trip the app's own gluten allergen check (src/data/allergens.js).
criteria.nut-free: No tree nuts or peanuts, incl. nut milks, nut butters and the pack's cashew sauces; must not trip the app's tree-nut/peanut check. Coconut is not counted as a tree nut (FDA, 2025) but is named in the reason.
criteria.soy-free: No tofu, soy drink/yogurt, soy sauce, tamari, miso, edamame or soy mayonnaise; an unspecified "plant milk"/"plant yogurt" fails (it is often soy). Must not trip the app's soy check.
criteria.oil-free: No oil of any kind in the ingredients (olive, rapeseed, sesame, coconut; also mayonnaise and commercial hummus) and no oil in the method text. Whole-food fats (nuts, seeds, tahini, avocado, olives) are allowed.
criteria.no-added-sugar: No sugar, syrup, honey, sweetened dried fruit, ketchup, fruit juice (lemon/lime juice exempt) or oat drink (its enzymatic maltose counts as added): WHO "free sugars". Whole/dried fruit and dates (also blended or as date paste) are allowed and named in the reason. Erythritol (Sukrin) is allowed and named.
criteria.quick: Prep + cook ≤ 20 min (stored, or proposed here when missing) and no soaking, rising, chilling, setting, fermenting, sprouting or overnight step.
criteria.batch-friendly: Makes ≥ 4 servings and keeps ≥ 3 days chilled or freezes: soups, stews, bakes, burgers/patties/balls, breads, granola, porridges, spreads/dips (not avocado-based), cooked or nut-based sauces, jams, ferments. Not leafy or avocado salads, drinks, crisps.
criteria.kid-friendly: Judgement, low confidence. Never for the FMD pack (a fasting protocol). A meal, snack, side or dessert (not a component, not a salad other than fruit/potato salad), no chilli/cayenne/hot sauce/horseradish, and a familiar format: porridge, pancakes, waffles, oats, smoothies, bread/buns, burgers/balls/patties, lasagne/pizza, potatoes/fries/mash, smooth soups, hummus, jam, desserts. Whole nuts: choking risk under 5, named in the reason.

decisionsNeeded: Dates and date paste do NOT count as added sugar: allowed under "no-added-sugar" (WHO definition); 44 recipes keep the label on dates.

Oat drink sugars (~4 g/100 ml, enzymatic maltose) DO count as added sugar: oat drink is a free-sugar ingredient for no-added-sugar, weight-loss and diabetes-friendly, and its sugars are added to addedSugar (stored panels corrected), which the heart and blood-pressure checks read.
Canned beans and broth stay as written; labels keep the conservative sodium assumption (ordinary salted products unless the row says otherwise).
Bread serving = 2 slices (sliced loaves); granola serving = 50 g. The planner scales the shopping list by servings, so a planned "serving" now buys 2 slices' worth.
